headline: NBA leans 18-13 on 2026-11-20 (0 staked picks). Main miss reason was usage shifting to a teammate (5 of 13): Fox, Dosunmu and Clingan got few shots, and Lillard scored 33 with 0 assists.
B2B gap widened to +19pp (17 team-games, still a candidate) after MIL and GSW, both on B2Bs, went 4-7. Favoured-by-10+ fell from +15pp to +5pp and is dead again. AST and PTS stay RELIABLE.

hits_note: Stephon Castle 3-0 (AST 12, PTS 21, REB 6) with Harper out. He got the creation Fox didn't (1 team-game, a story only).
Kris Dunn REB o1.5 hit on exactly 2 despite playing 5.7 min below average. The low rung survived the minutes cut that sank the 2.5.
Lendeborg AST and REB hit in a 28-point loss. Full minutes meant the blowout didn't matter for him, and his 7 assists are the ones Podziemski didn't get.
Derrick Jones Jr. PTS o7.5 hit on 3 FGA thanks to 5 FTA. It's the same low-shot squeeze that cost him 0-2 on 2026-11-18, and he survived it by 0.5.
Clingan REB o11.5 got 13 despite 5 fouls (normal minutes). Fouls didn't limit him.
adds: Usage shifts lead again. USAGE-SHIFT (5 today) is now the most common miss tag. Every one had normal minutes. The shots or playmaking went to a teammate who surged: Kuminga, Castle, Scoot, Lendeborg, Holiday. None of that could be seen pre-game.

B2B is getting harder to dismiss. The gap widened to +19pp (CI +9 to +28, 17 team-games). MIL (B2B, 1-4) and GSW (B2B, 3-3) fed it. It's still a candidate and needs 30 team-games. Favoured-by-10+ collapsed from +15pp to +5pp after SAS went 5-1 as 15.5-point favourites. That supports the B2B-first reading from yesterday's split idea.

GSW without Curry is now 4 games, all losses of 21+ (-38, -21, -22, -28). Podziemski is 2-4 and Lendeborg 3-3 in Curry-out games (2 team-games each in pattern_stats). Lendeborg PTS is 0-2, missing by 8.5 both times. The OUTLIFT boost for Curry's absence isn't showing up in their scoring.
Noise: Herro's near-miss on the upper rung, Wagler's 3-10, and Jaquez's 3-11 on normal shot volume.
